title: Lesson 2.1: The CIA Triad & Other Security Models

story.vex: Slip through a gap in any of your three A's. There's always one open. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED before it started: every log gap is named and closed. Astro: "Authentication, authorization, accounting — miss one, and CIA pays for it later."

files.C:\\Citadel\\README.txt:
ORDERS FROM ASTRO
=================
Read access-log.txt: four flagged entries. Classify each by which AAA step is missing: authentication, authorization, or accounting.

1. type access-log.txt
2. classify <entry> authentication | authorization | accounting
files.C:\\Citadel\\access-log.txt:
FLAGGED ACCESS LOG ENTRIES
----------------------------
entry-1   03:00 relay console accessed with NO password check at all
entry-2   03:05 cadet 'orin' (Users group) opened the Captain's private log (no permission check ran)
entry-3   03:10 an admin action ran on the shield generator but nothing was written to any log
entry-4   03:15 a login attempt was correctly verified, and the session was correctly scoped, but no record of it exists anywhere

steps.title: Read the flagged log
steps.body: Rivet: "Four entries, four gaps. Read them first." `type access-log.txt`.

steps.title: Name the missing A
steps.body: Astro: "No password check is a missing authentication. No permission check is a missing authorization. Nothing written to the log is a missing accounting." Classify all four entries.

objectives.label: entry-1 classified as authentication (no password check)
entry-2 classified as authorization (no permission check)
entry-3 classified as accounting (no log written)
entry-4 classified as accounting (verified and scoped, but never recorded)
